cues.text: This is a sample lesson. First, load it on Office Wi-Fi to get a baseline.
Now switch to Simulated 3G. The text appears straight away, but the media takes much longer.
Find the file that is holding things up. Here, it is the 42 MB hero video.
Optimise it. The size drops, but nothing runs again until you choose to re-test.
Re-test on Simulated 3G, under the same conditions.
Same lesson, same connection. The video now loads in 1.5 seconds, instead of 10.5.
